verdict.rationale: Raygun's own docs mention uploading dSYMs (iOS symbolication) and ProGuard mapping files (Android deobfuscation), which implies native iOS and Android crash capture. Its crash reports show environment, version, OS and host context, filterable by version and OS. However, no evidence shows dedicated iOS/Android SDK documentation, NDK/native C/C++ crash support, or device-model context. missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android SDK docs, NDK crash capture, device-level context (model/hardware), independent hands-on corroboration of mobile crash reporting.
